Final Frontier · game prototype audio

Final Frontier Sound Board

Every sound in the game, synthesised from numbers by tools/gen_sounds.py (no recordings). Files live in game/sounds/<group>/<name>.wav; a real recording with the same name replaces one. Previews here are 22 kHz copies of the 44.1 kHz game files. Loops repeat on their own.

Interface Buttons, panels, tutorial cards and placing buildings. Quietest group. game/sounds/ui/

hover

0.04 s

Pointer over a button: a faint 45 ms tick, high and soft.

click

0.09 s

Button press: two quick rising console chirps.

back

0.12 s

Back / close button: the same chirp, falling.

locked

0.17 s

Locked button: a dull, muted double tick.

open

0.43 s

A panel opens: three rising notes with a short airy swish.

close

0.41 s

A panel closes: three falling notes.

confirm

0.49 s

Order accepted: two-tone up with a bell overtone.

error

0.46 s

Refused: low two-tone, soft square wave, falling.

tutorial

0.87 s

Tutorial card pops up: a soft bloop and a chime.

tutorial_done

1.25 s

Tutorial step complete: rising three-note chime with a sparkle.

place

0.58 s

Building placed: a solid thunk, a chirp and a short hiss.

cancel

0.34 s

Placement cancelled: soft downward sweep.

Landing Drop ships coming down, unloading and the outpost unfurling. Loudest group; the two loops repeat seamlessly. game/sounds/landing/

burn_loop

3.00 sloop

Rocket roar (loop): rumble, mid roar, crackle; driven by throttle in game.

burn_ignite

1.70 s

Engine lights: valve hiss, igniter crack, roar swell.

engine_cut

1.90 s

Engine shuts off: roar collapses, valve chuff, hot metal ticking.

touchdown

1.90 s

Touchdown: heavy thump, gear creak, strut ring, rebound.

ramp_open

2.50 s

Ramp lowers: unlatch, hydraulic servo run, ramp meets the ground.

ramp_close

2.25 s

Ramp raises: servo run, shut, latch, seal hiss.

liftoff

3.30 s

Lift-off: ignition crack and a 3 s roar swell that trails away.

winch_loop

2.00 sloop

Cable pay-out (loop): winch motor, ratchet pawl, rope hiss.

module_clamp

1.20 s

Module locks on: metal clunk, second jaw, short ring.

unfurl

5.00 s

Outpost unfurls (5 s): three servo runs with latch clicks, mast detents, lock and hiss.

uplink

1.65 s

Uplink to the ship: rising comms chirps, data warble, two-tone ping.

vehicle_roll

1.90 s

Vehicle drives down the ramp: drive whine, rib clunks, thud onto the ground.
